popover.$description: Tokens for Popover: a panel that opens from a button and sits next to it (AcmeCo's header menu; later the filter dropdowns, audit F17). Measured from AcmeCo's menu (live site, 2026-10-10); the look matches the Select's list so every panel in the system is one style. Decision 36.

border.$description: PROPOSED: the 1px line the Select's list has (AcmeCo's menu has none, only a shadow); kept so every panel matches. Decorative.

shadow.$description: OBSERVED: 1px 0 25px 2px at 30% black on the menu; became shadow.raised, the system's one level for menus, popovers and dialogs.

padding.$description: PROPOSED: 8px inside the panel (the menu's rows sat about 4px from its top).

offset.$description: OBSERVED: the menu opens about 5px under its button; became 4px.
